name: Ramp
text: We should implement high-contrast focus rings that appear immediately upon keyboard navigation. This visually aids users relying on keyboard navigation, ensuring they can easily see which element is active and improving overall usability. The trade-off here is the potential for visual distractions for mouse users, but the increased accessibility for keyboard users outweighs this concern. Making sure all users can effectively navigate the interface is our priority.

name: Reader
text: High-contrast focus rings risk creating a visual "siren" effect, overwhelming users with low vision or cognitive disabilities. A better alternative is a subtle focus ring that still meets WCAG contrast but avoids drawing excessive attention. Settle this by testing both options with users who rely on keyboard navigation and measure task completion time and reported comfort.
